findings.message: Proposed end-of-life date 2027-04-16 exceeds the maximum allowed date 2027-01-16 (today 2026-10-16 + 3 months). The application is upstream-sourced and no support plan is documented. Either reduce the EOL date to within the cap or provide a documented support plan for maintainer approval.
